latest.name: Recraft Studio (Recraft V4.1)
latest.short_verdict: A useful free design-first image workspace: 30 credits refresh every 24 hours, and Recraft V4.1 raster/vector variants are available on the Free plan. The key catch is that free outputs are public, owned by Recraft and not licensed for commercial use.
latest.what_it_does: Recraft Studio is a browser-based AI visual workspace for text-to-image creation and image editing. It supports raster images, editable SVG vector output, mockups, background removal, erasing, upscaling, vectorization, recoloring and prompt-based edits. Recraft's V4.1 family includes standard, Pro, Utility, Vector and Flash variants; its official model documentation says the V4.1 variants can be tested on every plan, including Free.
latest.why_try_it: It is more than a prompt-to-picture page: the same canvas can be used to explore styles, create visual concepts, produce editable SVGs and refine an image. That makes it worth testing for personal concept art, social graphics, icons and mockups. The free tier is suitable for evaluation and non-commercial experiments, not client-ready commercial delivery.
latest.free_tier: Free account: 30 credits renewed every 24 hours, with no credit card required according to Recraft's official product page. The page also markets up to 30 free image generations per day, but this is not a guaranteed count of finished outputs: credit use varies by model and operation. Recraft V4.1 variants are available to test on the Free plan.
latest.limits: Free-plan assets are owned by Recraft, publicly visible in its community gallery and not licensed for commercial use. Credit consumption varies by model/action; agentic or iterative requests can trigger multiple chargeable operations and consume substantially more credits than one simple generation. Recraft's Terms say credits already consumed are not returned when an operation fails to complete or the result is unsatisfactory. A fixed number of completed images per day cannot be guaranteed. API usage is separately billed in API Units; do not assume Studio free credits cover API calls.
latest.signup_pakistan: Recraft's Terms reviewed on 2026-11-09 do not name Pakistan as an excluded country, but they reserve eligibility discretion and require users to be at least 18 and register an account. The official product page says a credit card is not required for the free tier. A live Pakistan-based signup was not performed, and acceptance of Pakistan-issued cards for paid plans was not verified. Recraft says paid payments use credit cards, debit cards or bank transfers through Stripe; that does not confirm every Pakistani issuer will work.
latest.quality_evidence: Vendor claims: Recraft says V4.1 is designed for natural-looking images and offers raster, vector and Utility variants; it states all V4.1 variants are testable on Free. Independent evidence: the Artificial Analysis AA-Image-T2I v2.1 leaderboard checked on 2026-11-09 ranks Recraft V4.1 Utility at #32 (Elo 1028±11; 7,727 samples) and V4.1 Utility Pro at #40 (Elo 1018±9; 15,690 samples). The leaderboard uses blind pairwise human-preference votes; these are model-variant rankings, not a score for the whole Studio app. Adoption signal: Google Play showed 1M+ downloads and 4.7 stars from about 3.99K reviews; this is platform data, not a quality benchmark. Anecdotal feedback: Trustpilot showed 2.3/5 across 46 reviews, with both positive and negative recent experiences, including reports of unexpectedly high credit consumption and mixed output quality. This small, self-selected review sample is not representative.
latest.android_status: Verified official Google Play listing: “Recraft: AI Images and Videos” by Recraft, Inc. The listing showed 1M+ downloads, 4.7 stars and about 3.99K reviews, and was updated on 2026-11-02 when checked. The Pakistan-specific Play Store storefront/install availability was not independently confirmed.
